theme: A travel day — Tampa to Toronto for the ICGN conference.
greeting: The morning's yours in St. Pete before a 4:20 flight north; by tonight you're in Toronto with the ICGN plenary and board dinner on deck for tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: ICGN plenary and board dinner in Toronto
needsAttention.detail: You're on Plenary 7 at the ICGN Autumn Conference, with the board dinner tomorrow evening at Lee Restaurant; skim the final speaker brief and the Plenary 7 planning notes before you land.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The full-size Portland SUV for Christmas week is your flagged 'book this week' p1 and is weeks past due; a refundable hold now takes the holiday-inventory risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The all-four-girls Dec 13-Jan 2 trip was to be decided by Sept 30 and booked by Oct 15; holiday inventory for six is thinning, so pick the domestic-or-international path and book.

schedule.title: Flight to Toronto
schedule.detail: Porter PD526, Tampa (TPA) to Toronto, landing 7:17 PM ET.

flagged.title: Amex flagged account changes
flagged.detail: American Express sent an 'important account changes' notice on your card; worth opening to confirm nothing's off before you travel.

flagged.title: KLA - VP, Global Government Affairs
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert for a VP of Global Government Affairs & Strategic Policy role that lines up with your public-affairs track.

inbox.noise: The rest is listing alerts, shipping receipts, a Deloitte tax-enrollment notice, and newsletters.

resolved.title: Conference ticket being sorted
resolved.detail: Jen Sisson confirmed Oct 28 she'd arrange your complimentary ICGN conference ticket through Elle.

recipe.title: Chanterelle salad
recipe.why: Chanterelles are at their golden autumn peak right now, earthy and worth cooking before the frost.

acts.line: A clear morning in St. Pete to pack and clear the decks before the airport.
A 4:20 Porter flight out of Tampa, wheels-down in Toronto by 7:17 for the conference.
Settle into Toronto with the plenary and tomorrow's board dinner just ahead.
